caseName: Cafeteria & Restaurant Workers Union, Local 473 v. McElroy
caseNameFull: Cafeteria & Restaurant Workers Union, Local 473, AFL-CIO v. McElroy
attorneys: Bernard Dunau for petitioners. Solicitor General Cox for respondents.

opinions.text: Certiorari, 364 U. S. 813, to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit. The motion of petitioners to substitute Robert S. McNamara in the place of Thomas S. Gates as a party respondent is denied. The motion of respondent to dismiss as to the respondent, Thomas S. Gates, individually and as Secretary of Defense, is denied.
